harness.scene: The area is a 3D scan of a real mountain gorge: rock walls, a stream bed, boulders and plants, open to the sky. An altitude geofence a few metres above the ground acts like a roof, so the drone cannot climb over tall obstacles.

licence.detail: CC BY 4.0, matching the owner metadata retrieved 2026-11-20 from https://superspl.at/scene/8652a3e8.

review.detail: Review decision “pending”: Picked from the PlayCanvas explore API as a candidate outdoor scene (mountains, forests, natural landscapes, small villages); look not yet approved.

scale.detail: Not measured. Recorded so far: Scene units treated as metres at scale 1, without independent calibration. (Shown for information; not enforced.)

passage.detail: Narrowest gap on the flight graph: 0.94 m (the drone is 0.50 m wide) at [23.9, 45.1, -25.7].

alignment.detail: 32.9% of 4049 sampled surface cells of the scan's own collider (the altitude fence and sealed hollows excluded) have scan points within 0.70 m (needs 90%).

coverage.detail: 68.2% of 220 waypoints have captured scan ground below them (needs 90%). Captured means at least 64 scan points within 2 m (5% of this scan's median, 1280). 23 waypoints sit over ground with no scan surface within 2.5 m (ground we sealed).

scene-text.detail: The area is a 3D scan of a real mountain gorge: rock walls, a stream bed, boulders and plants, open to the sky. An altitude geofence a few metres above the ground acts like a roof, so the drone cannot climb over tall obstacles.

routes.detail: 108 routes (12 train, 24 dev, 24 heldout, 48 test) match sim/scenarios/reach-daregahan-gorge.json.

between.detail: Reactive avoider 79.2%, between straight 54.2% and planner 100%.

missions-search.detail: Sets match sim/scenarios/mission-daregahan-gorge-search.json. Each target used once. Oracle completed 4 of 4 development missions.

targets-captured.detail: 84 of 84 targets have at least 64 scan points within 2 m (5% of this scan's median, 1280).

targets-sky.detail: 84 of 84 targets are in their column's topmost free space.
